FormatContextBundleOutput.description:
Compact result of ``sumo_qa_format_context_bundle`` (issue #149).

Pure file/format plumbing — the host supplies the already-gathered issue/PR/
diff/CI/test facts, this tool validates them and renders a host-neutral
markdown brief plus a one-line roll-up. It performs NO inference and makes NO
network call. ``stale_evidence_fields`` and ``untrustworthy_evidence_fields``
surface the safety-honesty signal: a non-empty ``untrustworthy_evidence_fields``
means at least one present CI/test fact is not a fresh pass and MUST NOT back
a safe-to-merge claim. ``conflict`` is set when the bundle's head_sha differs
from a supplied local head — the consumer calls out the divergence rather than
trusting either side.

changed_file_count.description: Number of changed files in the validated bundle.
changed_file_count.title: Changed File Count

compact_summary.description: One-line roll-up of the bundle's trust state.
compact_summary.title: Compact Summary

conflict.description: Bundle-vs-local-state conflict message when head shas differ, else None.
conflict.title: Conflict

stale_evidence_fields.description: Go-stale fields whose evidence is explicitly stale (e.g. ['ci_status']).
stale_evidence_fields.title: Stale Evidence Fields

tool.description: Tool discriminator; always the literal tool name.
tool.title: Tool

untrustworthy_evidence_fields.description: Present go-stale fields that are NOT a fresh pass (stale/unknown/absent/failing/mixed). Non-empty ⇒ no safety claim may rest on bundle evidence.
untrustworthy_evidence_fields.title: Untrustworthy Evidence Fields

ErrorEnvelope.description:
The MCP tool error envelope returned by ``sumo_qa.server._error_envelope``.

Used as the typed alternative to a bare ``dict`` in every tool's return
annotation. Without this, FastMCP would emit an unconstrained
``additionalProperties: true`` schema arm, allowing any shape through and
defeating the outputSchema contract.

``isError`` is ``Literal[True]`` so Pydantic + FastMCP treat it as a
discriminator, routing between each tool's success model and this
envelope in the emitted ``anyOf``/``oneOf`` schema.

error.description: Structured error payload with type, message, and actionable_hint.

isError.description: Marks the response as an error per the MCP error-shape convention.
isError.title: Iserror

ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

RepoMapScanOutput.description:
Compact summary of a ``sumo_qa_scan_repo`` invocation.

Deliberately omits the full ``nodes`` / ``edges`` arrays — those can be
tens of thousands of entries on a large repo and would blow past the
host's per-tool token budget. Callers that need the full artifact pass
a ``write_to`` path and read it from disk, or use the
``sumo_qa.repo_map_scanner.scan_repo`` Python API directly.

artifact_bytes.description: Size of the written artifact in bytes, when write_to was provided.
artifact_bytes.title: Artifact Bytes

artifact_path.description: Absolute path the full artifact was written to, when write_to was provided.
artifact_path.title: Artifact Path

edge_count.description: Total number of edges in the produced artifact.
edge_count.title: Edge Count

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this scan ran.
generated_at.title: Generated At

generator_version.description: Generator version string passed by the caller.
generator_version.title: Generator Version

git_commit.description: HEAD commit SHA when root IS a git toplevel; null otherwise.
git_commit.title: Git Commit

name.description: Project name (resolved from the root directory's basename).
name.title: Name

node_count.description: Total number of nodes in the produced artifact.
node_count.title: Node Count

root.description: Absolute, resolved root path that was scanned.
root.title: Root

schema_version.description: Schema version of the underlying RepoMap artifact (currently '1.0').
schema_version.title: Schema Version

tool.description: Tool discriminator; always the literal tool name.
tool.title: Tool

warning_count.description: Total number of warnings emitted by the scan.
warning_count.title: Warning Count
